post_slowdown_asr_text: The river stopped him. Its bridge was gone. Rain made the water brown and dangerously fast. He stepped back, ran, and jumped into the flood. The water pulled him under, but he fought toward the light. He grabbed a branch and pulled himself onto the far bank. Later, three men blocked his way, and a knife flashed. He hit the man holding it with his walking stick. He ran uphill as their shouts followed behind him.
